subject: *: replace GetTableStats with GetPhysicalTableStats (#62790)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs parent, focusing on production changes under pkg/executor, pkg/planner, and pkg/statistics/handle. The change is an API rename/clarification to fetch stats by physical table/partition ID (GetPhysicalTableStats) plus a non-pseudo cache fetch helper (GetNonPseudoPhysicalTableStats), with call sites updated to pass correct physical IDs (table ID for non-partition/global stats, partition ID for partition stats). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/concurrency/transaction behavior within the scoped modules.
